Download HeadStart for Codex ↓

Version 0.3.0 · ZIP · Local preview · Python 3.10+

A small install. A head start.

  1. Extract the ZIP into a permanent folder.

    Keep its hidden .agents folder. You need Codex with plugin support and Python available as python3. This preview is tested on macOS; Linux and Windows are not yet verified.

  2. Open a terminal in the extracted folder.

    If you already have a marketplace named personal, resolve that name conflict first; keep your existing marketplace intact.

    codex plugin marketplace add .
codex plugin add headstart-plugin@personal
  3. Start a new Codex thread.

    Try: “Use HeadStart to find three starting points for a cozy browser game with farming, exploration and building.” A successful catalog tool response confirms the connection.

Discovery works today.

The plugin searches bundled metadata locally, with no API key. It includes six agent skills and no upstream game source or images. Website bag sync, source-code delivery, automatic remixing and royalty services are still being built. Downloading does not install or connect the plugin.
